extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, patent attorneys, law students, and patent examiners (U.S. practice)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical and legal guidance on U.S. patent prosecution, claim drafting, statutory requirements (35 U.S.C. §§101,102,103,112), appeals, and post-issuance proceedings. A practice-oriented treatise covering standards and procedures used by practitioners and examiners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent protection -- Prosecution and appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage of patent protection as it relates to prosecution before the Patent Office and appeals from Office actions and decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prosecution history estoppel and disclaimer considerations
rubrics_metrics.description: Issues and considerations arising from prosecution history estoppel and disclaimer that can affect claim scope and enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventorship
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and standards for determining inventorship in patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Antedating prior art references under Rule 131
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for antedating prior art references pursuant to Rule 131 (showing earlier public accessibility or prior invention to overcome cited prior art).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to patentable subject matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussion of categories or doctrines that render subject matter ineligible for patenting (i.e., exceptions to patentable subject matter).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipation standard under 35 U.S.C. Section 102
rubrics_metrics.description: The legal standard and practice for anticipation under 35 U.S.C. §102 (novelty requirement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Combating obviousness rejections under 35 U.S.C. Section 103
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies and standards for responding to and combating obviousness rejections under 35 U.S.C. §103 (inventive step/non-obviousness).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure under 35 U.S.C. Section 112, first paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the specification under 35 U.S.C. §112, first paragraph (written description, enablement, and disclosure obligations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definite claims under 35 U.S.C. Section 112, second paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that claims be definite under 35 U.S.C. §112, second paragraph (claim definiteness standards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Means-plus-function or step-plus-function claims under 35 U.S.C. Section 112, sixth paragraph
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and requirements for means-plus-function (or step-plus-function) claim elements under 35 U.S.C. §112, sixth paragraph, including necessary disclosure of structure/acts/ materials corresponding to the claimed function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related application and priority issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedural issues relating to related patent applications and priority/priority claims (e.g., benefit/priority chain, provisional/continuation practice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design patent requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements specific to design patents (as distinct from utility patents), including statutory and practice considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-issuance actions : reissue, reexamination, certificates of correction, and maintenance fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-issuance remedies and proceedings such as reissue, reexamination, certificates of correction, and maintenance fee practice and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical guidelines for drafting patent opinions
rubrics_metrics.description: Practice-oriented guidance for preparing patentability, validity, and freedom-to-operate opinions and other practitioner analyses.
